entries.topic: ALICE TOO COLD clock runs while walking and inside
originals: Whether the 12 minutes of ALICE TOO COLD run only while standing still,
entries.answer: The time counts in total, whatever Kara does, and entering buildings does not reset it; the scene fires when Kara next moves Alice after the time is up, not while standing still.
entries.source: PowerPyx Fugitives comments: k (2021-06-27) 'Just spend that time (in total) on the street doing whatever, even entering the buildings will not reset this timer'; Big Daddy (2023-01-22) 'Making Alice walk after standing in the cold triggers it'; Marcus (2018-10-17) stood 25 minutes without it firing

entries.topic: Arrows and prompts after the robbery
originals: Lie / truth / apologize after a robbery?
entries.answer: One arrow on Alice's 'How did you get it?': SmallUp if Kara convinced the clerk (automatic LIE), otherwise SmallDown. TRUTH leads to FACTUAL / JUSTIFY / UNCERTAIN / APOLOGIZE (APOLOGIZE SmallUp); LIE has no arrow. After the diversion (its own SmallDown), the four come directly with no lie option.
entries.source: Template ch10 'Try to steal money' (NOTE 'If Kara convinced the clerk ... directly to the LIE option with an increase', ARROW Alice SmallUp / SmallDown; TRUTH/LIE; diversion variant FACTUAL/JUSTIFY/UNCERTAIN/APOLOGIZE)

entries.topic: No second try at clothes or money
originals: Whether Kara can re-enter the laundromat after the man wakes, and the store
entries.answer: Once the clothes or the money attempt has failed, it cannot be retried, so closing the laundromat after the man wakes and the store after any robbery attempt matches the game.
entries.source: PowerPyx 'If you have failed one of these two things, you can't get into the Motel on your current playthrough'; PowerPyx 'Disturb Man: Fail the QTE to wake the man and leave the shop again – with no clothes'; wiki 'leave the abandoned house after meeting Ralph ... closes off the Squat ending'

originals: Being caught is deterministic, as PowerPyx says
entries.answer: Deterministic: one item is safe, a second is always seen, even across visits.
entries.source: PowerPyx 'Stealing a second item will always get you busted'; wiki Notes 'If you steal two items, the store clerk will still catch you, even if Kara stole an item and then returned later'
